digest.component_or_area: Jira DC harness - Epic field readiness gate
propositions: The readiness gate waits for Epic Link and Epic Name fields at session start before any Jira Software project is created, but GreenHopper only provisions these fields when the first such project is created, resulting in an ordering deadlock.
The harness errors all 62 cells at fixture setup because the capability check cannot be satisfied by waiting alone; it requires the action (project creation) that the blocking gate prevents.

The field inventory remains byte-identical at 27 fields with zero customfield entries after 180 seconds of quiet time without project creation, but immediately becomes 55 fields with 13 customfield entries within 0.05 seconds after project creation.

The fix relocates the Epic field check from session-start readiness to the _assert_project_capabilities hook that runs immediately after project provisioning, reordering the dependency to eliminate the deadlock.

The field readiness budget must be sized from actual provisioning measurements (0.0512s observed) with 2400x headroom (120s timeout) rather than estimates, and the wait must record elapsed time on success to prevent future degradation.
